story: FWS proposes an incidental harassment authorization for AIDEA's winter seismic survey in the Arctic Refuge 1002 Area, with a polar bear den model in R estimating 8 dens (95 percent interval 2 to 16) and capping take at 10 Level B and 2 Level A (91 FR 73773, November 17th)

claims.claim: The applicant for the proposed authorization is the Alaska Industrial Development and Export Authority (AIDEA).
claims.verbatim: the Alaska Industrial Development and Export Authority (AIDEA)
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: SUMMARY section.

claims.claim: The activity area is the Coastal Plain 1002 Area of the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge.
claims.verbatim: Coastal Plain 1002 Area, located in Arctic National Wildlife Refuge
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: The seismic survey would begin during the winter of 2026-2027.
claims.verbatim: beginning during the winter of 2026-2027
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Applicant's plan; authorization only proposed. Write would begin.

claims.claim: The seismic program would use 12 rubber-tracked vibroseis vehicles.
claims.verbatim: using 12 rubber-tracked vibroseis vehicles
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: The program would deploy 37,500 wireless autonomous recording devices called nodes.
claims.verbatim: 37,500 wireless autonomous recording devices (nodes/geophones)
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: Up to two 180-person camp seismic crews may be supported.
claims.verbatim: Up to two 180-person-camp seismic crews may be supported
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: The advance crew will mobilize no earlier than January 10th.
claims.verbatim: The advance crew will mobilize no earlier than January 10th
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: FWS wrote the code for its den disturbance model in the program R.
claims.verbatim: We developed the code to run this model in the program R
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: FWS ran 10,000 iterations of the den model as a Monte Carlo simulation.
claims.verbatim: ran 10,000 iterations of the model (i.e., Monte Carlo simulation)
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: The model's inputs include the estimated number of dens in four regions of northern Alaska.
claims.verbatim: the estimated number of dens in four different regions of northern Alaska
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: FWS estimated 8.0 land-based dens in the area of specified activity, with a median of 8 and a 95 percent interval of 2 to 16.
claims.verbatim: We estimated 8.0 (median=8; 95 percent CI: 2-16) land-based dens
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Model estimate. Small Numbers item 2 also says on average eight dens are estimated within 1 mile of the activities.

claims.claim: The den disturbance model gives a median of 4 Level B takes per winter, with a 95 percent interval of 0 to 14.
claims.verbatim: Level B harassment 0.873 4.415 4 0-14
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Table 5 row cells: P(at least one take) 0.873, mean 4.415, median 4, 95% CI 0-14.

claims.claim: The den disturbance model gives a median of 2 Level A takes per winter, with a 95 percent interval of 0 to 11.
claims.verbatim: Level A harassment 0.753 3.034 2 0-11
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Table 5 row cells.

claims.claim: The den disturbance model puts the probability of at least one lethal take at 0.15, with a median lethal take of 0.
claims.verbatim: Lethal take 0.15 0.287 0 0-2
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Table 5 row cells. Authorization covers nonlethal take only.

claims.claim: FWS proposes to authorize take of no more than 10 polar bears by Level B harassment.
claims.verbatim: will cause the take of no more than 10 polar bears by Level B harassment and 2 polar bears by Level A harassment
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Den-only median is 4; the rest of the 10 comes from non-den sources (split not captured).

claims.claim: FWS proposes to authorize take of no more than 2 polar bears by Level A harassment.
claims.verbatim: will cause the take of no more than 10 polar bears by Level B harassment and 2 polar bears by Level A harassment
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: Take of 12 bears is 1.32 percent of the Southern Beaufort Sea stock estimate of 907 animals.
claims.verbatim: Take of 12 animals is 1.32 percent of the best available estimate of the current SBS stock size of 907 animals
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: Under a draft stock estimate of 819 bears, 12 bears would be 1.47 percent of the stock.
claims.verbatim: 12 bears constitute 1.47 percent of the SBS stock
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Companion fragment: the SBS polar bear stock has changed to 819 bears.

claims.claim: In the mitigation description, the first aerial infrared den survey would be flown between November 25th and December 25th.
claims.verbatim: The first survey would be flown between November 25 and December 25
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Section Air Surveys for Maternal Polar Bear Dens.

claims.claim: In the denning model, the first aerial infrared survey was set between December 1st and December 25th and the second between December 15th and January 15th, 2027.
claims.verbatim: The first survey would occur between December 1 and December 25, 2026
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Companion: the second survey between December 15, 2026, and January 15, 2027.

claims.claim: The proposed authorization's mitigation terms list aerial infrared survey dates in December 2025 and January 2026, a year earlier than the windows in the den model.
claims.verbatim: The first survey must occur between December 1 and December 25, 2025
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Proposed authorization, B. General Avoidance Measures, item 12; also 'the second survey must occur between December 15, 2025, and January 15, 2026'. Say the terms list 2025 dates; do not call it an error.

claims.claim: The model requires a minimum of 24 hours between the two aerial infrared surveys.
claims.verbatim: with a minimum of 24 hours between surveys
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: FWS says aerial infrared has been found to be four times more effective at detecting dens than ground-based FLIR.
claims.verbatim: AIR has been found to be four times more effective at detecting dens versus ground-based FLIR
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Attribute to FWS.

claims.claim: AIDEA will create a 1.6 km (1 mi) exclusion zone around any putative dens it locates.
claims.verbatim: AIDEA will create a 1.6 km (1 mi) exclusionary zone around any putative dens located.
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: The notice gives no numeric den detection probabilities and refers to the 2026-2031 Beaufort Sea ITR for them.
claims.verbatim: previously described in the 2026-2031 Beaufort Sea ITR
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: AIDEA will use a modeling framework called SnowDens to simulate snow accumulation before starting aerial infrared surveys.
claims.verbatim: a modeling framework called SnowDens, as described in Liston et al. (2025), to simulate snow accumulation
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: A snow model, not AI.

claims.claim: FWS says its modeling assumptions are more likely to contribute to an overestimate than an underestimate of take.
claims.verbatim: are more likely to contribute to an overestimate, rather than an underestimate
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Attribute to FWS.

claims.claim: FWS acknowledges its take estimates significantly exceed historical data collected over decades of similar oil and gas activity on the North Slope.
claims.verbatim: We recognize the limitations of our predictive models and take estimates that significantly exceed historical data collected over decades of similar oil and gas activity on Alaska's North Slope
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Quote as FWS's own words.

claims.claim: Comments on the proposed authorization must be received by December 17th.
claims.verbatim: Comments must be received by December 17, 2026.
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: The docket number for the proposed authorization is FWS-R7-ES-2026-4357.
claims.verbatim: Docket No. FWS-R7-ES-2026-4357
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: The notice was published in the Federal Register at 91 FR 73773 on November 17th.
claims.verbatim: Citation: 91 FR 73773
claims.source_outlet: Federal Register (federalregister.gov API)

claims.claim: FWS proposes a one-year authorization for nonlethal incidental harassment of small numbers of Southern Beaufort Sea polar bears.
claims.verbatim: proposes a one-year authorization for nonlethal incidental harassment of small numbers of Southern Beaufort Sea polar bears
claims.source_outlet: Federal Register (federalregister.gov API)
claims.notes: Abstract; quote substance.

claims.claim: The notice does not use the terms artificial intelligence, machine learning or drone.
claims.verbatim: None of these terms appear in the provided text.
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)
claims.notes: Negative finding over both reads. Say the notice never says AI; its model is a statistical simulation in R.

claims.claim: Alaska Beacon reported that a decision on AIDEA's seismic application is not expected until mid-January 2027.
claims.verbatim: a decision on AIDEA's application to conduct seismic activity is not anticipated until mid-January 2027
claims.source_outlet: Alaska Beacon via Alaska Public Media (James Brooks)

claims.claim: AIDEA said it would incur significant financial impact if forced to end its seismic program after November 29th.
claims.verbatim: AIDEA will incur significant financial impact if it is forced to terminate its seismic program after November 29, 2026
claims.source_outlet: Alaska Beacon via Alaska Public Media (James Brooks)
claims.notes: AIDEA's claim as reported.

claims.claim: Alaska Beacon reported that staging and preliminary work outside the refuge had begun and would ramp up further at the end of November.
claims.verbatim: Staging and preliminary work outside ANWR has already begun and will ramp up further at the end of November
claims.source_outlet: Alaska Beacon via Alaska Public Media (James Brooks)

claims.claim: The final Beaufort Sea incidental take regulations are effective through October 19th, 2031.
claims.verbatim: This rule is effective October 19, 2026 and remains effective through October 19, 2031.
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: The final Beaufort Sea rule estimates 22 takes of polar bears during denning over its five years.
claims.verbatim: 22 takes of 22 polar bears were during denning
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: The final Beaufort Sea rule's model also estimates 13 takes by Level A harassment of denning cubs.
claims.verbatim: the model also estimated 13 takes by Level A harassment of 13 denning cubs
claims.source_outlet: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Federal Register (govinfo)

claims.claim: AIDEA's board resolution authorizes up to $175.0 million for 1002 Area permitting and 3D seismic work.
claims.verbatim: The Authority is authorized to expend or encumber up to $175.0 million
claims.source_outlet: Alaska Industrial Development and Export Authority, Resolution G26-05
claims.notes: Covers permitting/regulatory work and 3D seismic; excludes drilling.

claims.claim: The same resolution authorizes up to $15.0 million for bids and rentals in the June 2026 Coastal Plain lease sale.
claims.verbatim: the Authority is authorized to expend or encumber up to $15.0 million, solely to pay bonus bids and the first two years of annual lease rentals
claims.source_outlet: Alaska Industrial Development and Export Authority, Resolution G26-05

claims.claim: On November 16th the DNR Commissioner's Office lifted the default on the Cosmopolitan Unit.
claims.verbatim: On November 16th, 2026, the Commissioner's Office lifted the default on the Cosmopolitan Unit
claims.source_outlet: Alaska DNR Division of Oil and Gas
claims.notes: Runner-up story.

claims.claim: DNR approved BlueCrest's 14th Cosmopolitan Unit Plan of Development with conditions on November 17th.
claims.verbatim: November 17, 2026 ... Re: Cosmopolitan Unit 14th POD - Approved with Conditions
claims.source_outlet: Alaska DNR Division of Oil and Gas

claims.claim: BlueCrest must spud the first Lower A ERD Tyonek gas development well no later than January 31st, 2027.
claims.verbatim: BlueCrest is required to spud the first Lower A ERD Tyonek Gas development well no later than January 31, 2027.
claims.source_outlet: Alaska DNR Division of Oil and Gas

claims.claim: BlueCrest must commence Tyonek gas production by March 31st, 2027.
claims.verbatim: BlueCrest will commence Tyonek Gas production by March 31, 2027.
claims.source_outlet: Alaska DNR Division of Oil and Gas

claims.claim: Average Cosmopolitan Unit gas production for the 12 months ending August 2026 was about 540 thousand cubic feet per day, down from 724 a year earlier.
claims.verbatim: Average gas production rate for a 12-month period ending August 2026 was approximately 540 thousand cubic feet per day, a decrease from 724 thousand cubic feet per day one year prior.
claims.source_outlet: Alaska DNR Division of Oil and Gas

claims.claim: As of August 31st, 2026 the Cosmopolitan Unit had cumulatively produced 9.63 billion cubic feet of gas.
claims.verbatim: As of August 31, 2026, the Cosmopolitan Unit cumulatively produced 2.76 million barrels of oil and 9.63 billion cubic feet of gas.
claims.source_outlet: Alaska DNR Division of Oil and Gas

claims.claim: As of August 31st, 2026 the Cosmopolitan Unit had cumulatively produced 2.76 million barrels of oil.
claims.verbatim: As of August 31, 2026, the Cosmopolitan Unit cumulatively produced 2.76 million barrels of oil and 9.63 billion cubic feet of gas.
claims.source_outlet: Alaska DNR Division of Oil and Gas

killed.claim: The code error fix in the final Beaufort Sea ITR took Level B denning takes from 6 to 22 and Level A from 4 to 13.
killed.why: The before figures do not appear in the 200,000 characters of 2026-21371 read; only the after figures survive (U02, U03).

killed.claim: The AIDEA board approved the budget by a 6-1 vote.
killed.why: No fetched page shows the tally (Beacon 403; resolution has a blank signature block).

killed.claim: AIDEA approved up to $175 million for seismic.
killed.why: Reframed as A01: the $175.0 million covers permitting and seismic.

killed.claim: The notice states a numeric per-den disturbance probability.
killed.why: Only in Table 4, not captured; use Table 5 outputs.

killed.claim: The notice states numeric AIR or FLIR detection probabilities.
killed.why: None; refers to the Beaufort Sea ITR (C25).

killed.claim: Contractor work outside the refuge ramps up at the end of November.
killed.why: 'Contractor' not in the article; survives as S03 without it.

fetch_log.why_repeat: 116,145-character page: tail read at offset 100000; one narrow repeat for Table 5 and full sentences.
